text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... What should I do, the pimple on my forehead...
is super noticeable...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(M-Maybe I should think about a proper
face-washing routine after all... But I don't really get it...)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
So anyway, that acne face wash had amazing reviews,
so I just had to buy it~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Really? Tell me how it feels later~!
I wanna make my skin all silky smooth too~.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (...W-What kind of facial cleanser does she use...? N-Not like I could ever ask... M-My bangs will hide it anyway, right...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Cheval Grand constantly hid her skin
breakouts with her hair, her acne took
a frustratingly long time to clear up...
